card.name: Time-span words before an event
card.fires_on: The word 'after' following a length of time (months, years, hours) and before a medical event such as MI or follow-up. Also fires at a few spots inside dosing text, such as 'with' before a body weight.

modes.label: After a time span
modes.description: 'after' comes right after a duration and leads into a cardiac event or follow-up.
